baseline.name: People
baseline.summary: Every person the detector boxed at ingest.

baseline.name: Scene captions
baseline.summary: What the reasoning model wrote about each segment.

modules.name: Restricted lane
modules.summary: Flags a person whose feet stay inside the forklift lane on this camera.
modules.evidence: Cosmos Reason proposes the lane from a camera frame; events are computed from YOLO11 person boxes. Image-space position, not calibrated distance.

modules.name: Near a forklift
modules.summary: Finds segments where the scene caption describes a person close to a forklift.
modules.evidence: VAST hybrid search over Cosmos Reason captions. The match score ranks relevance; it is not a safety confidence.
modules.query: a person standing or walking close to a forklift

modules.name: Lingering
modules.summary: Flags a person who stays in roughly the same spot for too long.
modules.evidence: Computed from YOLO11 person boxes tracked across frames.

modules.name: Crowding
modules.summary: Flags when more people than allowed are visible at once.
modules.evidence: Computed from YOLO11 person counts per frame.

industrial.name: Warehouse safety
industrial.summary: Factory rules: forklift lane, person next to a vehicle, blocked path, lingering, and crowding.

rules.violation: A person is inside the forklift lane.
A person stands or walks next to a forklift.

rules.name: Person near a vehicle
rules.query: a person standing or walking close to a vehicle, car, truck, or forklift
rules.violation: A person is close to a vehicle.

rules.name: Blocked path
rules.query: boxes, pallets, or equipment blocking a walkway, aisle, door, or exit
rules.violation: Material blocks a walkway or exit.
A person stayed in one place too long.
More people are in view than the limit.

hackathon.name: Office rules
hackathon.summary: Office clips only: do-not-enter, fire alarm, office entry, pizza missing at 12:30, food on other tables, a man entering the women's bathroom, and a moved table. Running indoors has no violation.

rules.name: Do not enter
rules.query: a person at a door marked do not enter
rules.violation: A person is at a door marked do not enter.

rules.name: Fire alarm
rules.query: a person standing at or pulling a fire alarm
rules.violation: A person is at the fire alarm.

rules.name: Office entry
rules.query: a person entering an office through an office door
rules.violation: A person is entering an office.

rules.name: Pizza at lunch
rules.query: the pizza was not on the lunch table at the promised time of 12:30
rules.violation: The pizza was not there at the promised time of 12:30.

rules.name: Pizza on other tables
rules.query: pizza or food left on a work table that is not the lunch table
rules.violation: Food is on a table that is not the lunch table.

rules.name: Women's bathroom
rules.query: a man entering the women's bathroom
rules.violation: A man is entering the women's bathroom.

rules.name: Table moved
rules.query: a table that has been moved out of place in an office

streets.name: Street safety
streets.summary: Watch this camera for a person next to a vehicle, lingering, or crowding.

rules.name: Person near a vehicle
rules.query: a person standing or walking close to a vehicle or car
rules.violation: A person is close to a vehicle.
A person stayed in one place too long.
More people are in view than the limit.

unsupported.topic: PPE such as hard hats, vests, or gloves
unsupported.why: The detector only boxes people; it does not classify protective equipment, and an occluded helmet would be unknown, not missing.

unsupported.topic: vehicle speed or physical distance in metres
unsupported.why: Measuring speed or distance needs calibrated camera geometry, which this archive does not provide.

unsupported.topic: fire, smoke, spills, or blocked exits
unsupported.why: No indexed footage or detector output covers these events.
The YOLO11 COCO detector returns no forklift class on this footage; forklifts are only described in captions.
